# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 111 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 111

Jesus said: "The heavens and the earth will be rolled up before you, and whoever lives from the Living One will not taste death." Does not Jesus say: "Whoever finds himself — the world is not worthy of him?"

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Before you" — the dissolution happens in front of, before the living witness
- "Will not taste death" — the Thomas/John idiomatic phrase for eternal life
- The meta-rhetorical question preserved ("Does not Jesus say...?")
